title: celtis caucasica var. tupalangi
intro: Celtis caucasica var. tupalangi, commonly known as the Caucasian hackberry tree, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include expectorant, diuretic, and anti-fever effects, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Celtis caucasica var. tupalangi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
